name: Al-Battani (Albatenius)
arabicName: محمد بن جابر بن سنان البتاني

biography.en: Al-Battani was a premier Islamic astronomer and mathematician who refined solar and lunar measurements and discovered the movement of the Sun's apogee.

contributions.en: Determined the solar year to be 365 days, 5 hours, 46 minutes, and 24 seconds (accurate to within 2 minutes).

discoveries.en: Discovered the secular variation of the eccentricity of the Earth's orbit and precession of equinoxes.

biography.en: Polymath and astronomer who calculated Earth's radius using trigonometric geodesy at Fort Nandana with unprecedented precision.

contributions.en: Calculated Earth's radius as 6,339.6 km (within 1% of modern WGS84 radius of 6,371 km).

discoveries.en: First to hypothesize that Earth rotates around its axis and proposed heliocentric planetary models.

biography.en: Chief timekeeper (Muwaqqit) of the Umayyad Mosque in Damascus whose non-Ptolemaic lunar and planetary models directly influenced Copernicus.

contributions.en: Eliminated the Ptolemaic equant by introducing epicyclic epicycles.

discoveries.en: Formulated the mathematical planetary models later used identical in Copernicus's De revolutionibus.

biography.en: Fatimid astronomer and mathematician known for his massive astronomical handbook Al-Zij al-Kabir al-Hakimi.

contributions.en: Recorded forty solar and lunar eclipses with high precision used centuries later by Simon Newcomb.

discoveries.en: Discovered prosthetic trigonometric formulas before logarithms were invented.

biography.en: Director of the Maragheh Observatory who invented the Tusi Couple mechanism.

contributions.en: Invented the Tusi couple to resolve linear motion from circular motion.

discoveries.en: Created the first non-Ptolemaic planetary model system.

name: Al-Farghani (Alfraganus)
arabicName: أبو العباس أحمد بن محمد بن كثير الفرغاني

biography.en: Abbasid astronomer involved in measuring the length of a terrestrial degree along the Tigris plain.

contributions.en: Wrote Elements of Astronomy which was the standard European textbook for 500 years.

biography.en: Sultan and astronomer who built the massive Samarkand Observatory and compiled the Zij-i Sultani star catalogue.

contributions.en: Catalogued 1,018 stars with minimal error using his 36-meter meridian arc.
